retraction.reason: Retracted in M21: the Convention on Equality of Rights and Duties, signed at Brasília on 7 September 1971, under which Portuguese in Brazil and Brazilians in Portugal hold the rights of nationals. A real and durable instrument, and nothing in this atlas follows from it — the atlas holds almost nothing of the Brazilian relationship after 1822.
